module_title: One District One Product (ODOP) - Foundational Matrix (Core Launch & Global Industrial Hubs)
introduction: The ODOP scheme is Uttar Pradesh's premier economic initiative designed to promote local arts, generate mass employment at the grassroots level, and transform indigenous crafts into global brands. At this foundational level, we will memorize the critical timeline and the top iconic industrial hubs whose products are historically famous.

core_concepts.title: ODOP Scheme Launch Baseline
core_concepts.description:
- **Launch Date:** **January 24, 2018** (Inaugurated on the occasion of 'Uttar Pradesh Diwas').
- **Brand Ambassador:** Bollywood actress Kangana Ranaut serves as the official face of the ODOP scheme.

core_concepts.title: Globally Iconic Handicraft & Metal Hubs
core_concepts.description:
These districts possess an absolute global monopoly over their designated products:
1. **Aligarh:** Locks & Hardware (Famously nicknamed the 'City of Locks').
2. **Kannauj:** Perfume / Ittar (The undisputed 'Perfume Capital of India').
3. **Firozabad:** Glassware / Glass Bangles (Culturally known as 'Suhag Nagari').
4. **Moradabad:** Metal Craft / Brassware (Celebrated as 'Pital Nagari' or the Brass City).
5. **Varanasi:** Banarasi Silk Sarees (World-renowned textile heritage).

core_concepts.title: Sovereign Leather Hubs
core_concepts.description:
Two primary districts are earmarked specifically for the leather supply chain under ODOP:
- **Kanpur Nagar:** Leather Products (Belts, bags, saddlery, and industrial leather leatherwear).
- **Agra:** Leather Footwear (A massive exporter of formal and structural shoes).

important_entities.name: Lucknow
important_entities.significance: The state capital, Lucknow, is designated for its exquisite traditional hand embroidery styles: **Chikankari** and **Zari-Zardozi**. This is one of the most repeatedly tested single-line questions across all state board exams.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: The Kanpur Urban vs. Rural Bifurcation
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
Examiners heavily exploit the nomenclature difference between these two twin districts. Always look at the suffix:
- **Kanpur Nagar (Urban):** Leather Products.
- **Kanpur Dehat (Rural):** Aluminium Utensils.
Do not read too quickly and swap these two!

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Morad gets the Brass, the Rural Dehat gets the Aluminium.
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Instantly maps **Moradabad** to **Brassware** and **Kanpur Dehat** to **Aluminium Utensils** to avoid intersection errors.

exam_strategy_tips: For basic objective exams, memorizing the launch date (January 24, 2018) and the structural anchors like Firozabad (Glass) and Moradabad (Brass) will easily fetch you direct marks.
